shortDescription: German retail sales fell more than expected in July, decreasing by 3.4% compared with the previous month, data showed on Tuesday.Analysts polled by Reuters had predicted a 0.4% increase.The federal statistics office publishes more details on its website.

children: German retail sales fell more than expected in July, decreasing by 3.4% compared with the previous month, data showed on Tuesday.
Analysts polled by Reuters had predicted a 0.4% increase.
The federal statistics office publishes more details on its website.
